samples.name: ATUM (THE SOLIPSIST)
samples.power: Autogenesis: Player creates a new rule from thin air.
samples.lore: Created himself to avoid paying union dues to parents. The ultimate freelancer.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Comic mythological wrestling. Subject: Frog-headed god emerging from void. Mood: Smug self-creation.

samples.name: NUN (THE SOUP)
samples.power: Reset Board: Flush all active cards. Return to the void.
samples.lore: Infinite dark water. The unscripted pre-show where nothing matters.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Cosmic horror wrestling poster. Subject: Dark primordial ocean swallowing cards. Mood: Eerie void.

items.title: Plato's Dungeon Raids: The Odyssey Edition

samples.name: NIETZSCHE
samples.power: Hammer of Transvaluation. Breaks stable fields to force new values.
samples.lore: Alignment: Poetic-Explosive.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Woodblock engraving. Subject: Wild-mustached philosopher smashing stone tablets with a sledgehammer. Mood: Explosive ecstatic fury.

samples.name: HANNAH ARENDT
samples.power: Civic Action / Power is created between people. / Can redirect conflict energy.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Film noir sketch. Subject: Sharp-eyed woman moving pawns on a tactical map table. Mood: Precise strategic calm.

items.title: Plato's Dungeon Raid: Bring Your Own Legend — Hero Set 01

samples.name: Lvl 1: The Foreclosed
samples.power: You read the eviction notice. You feel a small fire start in your chest.
samples.lore: The crown takes the field. The field remembers.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink and watercolor sketch. Subject: stoic bull reading eviction notice, smoldering farmhouse behind. Mood: quiet fury igniting.

samples.name: Lvl 2: The Pitchfork-Sworn
samples.power: You take what was once a farming tool and use it for something else.
samples.lore: Every revolt starts with a tool that was always a weapon.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink and watercolor. Subject: bull raising pitchfork on dirt road, determined eyes. Mood: turning point, silent resolve.

items.title: Plato's Dungeon Raid — Full Class Roster v05

samples.name: The First-Day Fighter
samples.power: You pick the class with no spells and no gimmick. You hit things with a sword.
samples.lore: Every party needs the one who read none of the rulebook and still showed up on time.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor ink. Subject: armored rhino fighter at dungeon entrance, reading no rulebook. Mood: cheerfully oblivious.

samples.name: The Second-Wind Fighter
samples.power: You catch your breath mid-fight. You are somehow still standing.
samples.lore: The fighter's superpower is not dying when everyone had already written him off.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor ink. Subject: battered rhino fighter exhaling steam mid-combat, enemies swarming. Mood: defiant, impossible.

samples.name: THE DRAMA RULE
samples.power: Play when a scene is calm. Force an immediate aggression check.
samples.lore: Peace is a failure of imagination. If it's quiet, you're doing it wrong.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: watercolor cartoon. Subject: two peacocks screaming at each other, worm judging. Mood: smug escalation.

samples.name: CHANDLER'S WALK-IN
samples.power: Interrupt any action. A new threat enters the scene immediately.
samples.lore: When in doubt, have a man come through the door with a gun.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: noir comic panel. Subject: fox in fedora kicking door open with tommy gun. Mood: explosive interruption.

samples.name: THE WEAVER
samples.power: The Great Reset. Forces all players to discard their 'Property' cards.
samples.lore: You will own nothing. The 2030 Agenda isn't a prediction; it's a schedule.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: pulp conspiracy comic. Subject: fat spider in top hat weaving neon web over globe. Mood: sinister omnipotence.

samples.name: THE PHILANTHRO-VAMPIRE
samples.power: Common Core Injection. Pay 2 Billion to standardize all opponent hands.
samples.lore: Funding the control grid, one grant at a time. The revolution will be funded.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: noir illustration. Subject: bat in business suit injecting glowing FUNDING syringe into school. Mood: predatory philanthropy.

samples.name: The Spoon Bender
samples.power: Telekinetic Flop: Force an opponent to reroll a die. If they roll a 1, their weapon bends and breaks.
samples.lore: CIA verified he could see grapes in a box but failed to draw a bunny. Millions spent on parlor tricks.
samples.artworkPrompt: Retro spy dossier style. Fox in Hawaiian shirt bending a spoon. Mood: fraudulent confidence.

samples.name: The Stargate Viewer
samples.power: Remote View: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Keep one, burn the rest.
samples.lore: 15% accuracy rate deemed "successful" by desperate bureaucrats terrified of Soviet mind-wizards.
samples.artworkPrompt: Classified document aesthetic. Owl with headphones and third eye. Mood: tense Cold War paranoia.

items.title: Romantic Love-Wrestling & Krass Kayfabe-Heartbreaks
items.deckType: Romance craft deck — writing mechanics as performative card game

samples.name: The Contrast Collider
samples.power: Force opponent to reveal their character's greatest strength. It instantly triggers your character's worst flaw.
samples.lore: Attraction is no accident. It's a collision. Strengths and weaknesses must violently clash to create the narrative spark.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ink with watercolor. Subject: Punk raccoon and elegant swan colliding mid-air, sparks flying. Mood: Magnetic chaos.

samples.name: The Complementary Crutch
samples.power: Attach to a wounded fighter. Their weakness becomes your healing potential, generating +3 Chemistry Tokens.
samples.lore: You don't complete me, you fix my specific psychological damage. No friction structure? No drama. Just decoration.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ink with watercolor. Subject: Bandaged goat leaning on a limping fox, both holding each other up. Mood: Tender dependency.

samples.name: DESTROY THIS DECK
samples.lore: This isn't a PDF. It's raw material. Print it. Cut along the dotted lines. If you don't cut it, it doesn't work.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Scissors cutting dotted lines on printed card. Mood: Anarchic liberation.

samples.name: PICK YOUR ACTOR
samples.lore: Draw a card. That's you now. You aren't playing a game; you're arguing a perspective.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Duck grabbing a card with gleam in eye. Mood: Sudden conviction.

samples.name: The Apparatchik
samples.power: Discard a player's loyalty token to save yourself.
samples.lore: The institution doesn't love you back. It just manages you as a resource.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: editorial cartoon. Subject: owl in brown suit trading loyalty chips. Mood: smug bureaucratic survival.

samples.name: The Grey Desk
samples.power: Stall the game for 3 turns. Nobody gets to play.
samples.lore: Treason doesn't wear a mask; a cheap suit and denies your pension.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: noir bureaucratic. Subject: mouse buried in paperwork at grey desk. Mood: suffocating institutional boredom.

items.title: Shadow Monopoly: The Great Octopus Wrestling Match — BlackRock, Vanguard & Co

samples.name: Uncle FrizzleBob's Kayfabizarro Expansion
samples.power: Play this card to completely ignore the rules of the base game.
samples.lore: The illusion of choice is a carefully constructed farce. Welcome to the Geopolitical Shadow Monopoly.
samples.artworkPrompt: Ink collage. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit presenting expansion scroll to audience. Mood: anarchic welcome.

samples.name: The Octopus Analogy
samples.power: Bind 4 of your opponent's cards. They belong to you now.
samples.lore: A single hidden head controlling economic tentacles gripping the globe. Less than a handful of mega-corporations own your morning coffee and your digital soul.
samples.artworkPrompt: Ink. Subject: Giant octopus gripping globe with dollar-sign tentacles. Mood: quietly ominous.

items.title: Shakespearean Animal Beatdown — The Shakespearean Expansion

samples.name: Hamlet
samples.power: Flip a Coin. If heads, do something. If tails, do nothing.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Dramatic ink wash. Subject: Cartoon rabbit prince staring at a gold coin. Mood: Existential despair with velvet cape.

samples.name: Lady M.
samples.power: Permanently mark a target of your choice. They cannot escape your attention.
samples.lore: Out, out damned spot!
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic storybook. Subject: Cartoon rabbit queen scrubbing her paw obsessively. Mood: Regal paranoia.

samples.name: THE 360 DEAL
samples.power: TAKE half of target player's resource tokens. You own their merch, touring, and soul.
samples.lore: They say it's a partnership. A tick also calls the dog a partner.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ink cartoon. Subject: Octopus in suit signing contract with small rabbit. Mood: Predatory menace.

samples.name: THE NAIVE PRODIGY
samples.power: GAIN +2 Hype, but cannot read card text for the next 3 turns.
samples.lore: I coulda been a contender! Instead, I'm a tax write-off.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor cartoon. Subject: Starry-eyed lamb with guitar before towering record label. Mood: Innocent vulnerability.

samples.name: Behold a Pale Horse
samples.power: Aliens are real. HIV was a test, and the Illuminati run the DMV. Everything is a dot waiting to be connected.
samples.lore: DISCLOSURE EVENT: Force another player to reveal their hidden agenda (or hand). If they refuse, the aliens take their turn.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Conspiracy corkboard. Subject: Owl detective connecting dots under UFO. Mood: Paranoid revelation.

samples.name: The Synagogue of Satan
samples.power: A timeline of how a secret high council of 'Luciferian' elites supposedly rented out world history.
samples.lore: SHADOW COUNCIL: You may change the Quest Die result by +1/-1 by claiming 'we paid for this outcome.'
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Gothic cartoon. Subject: Octopus in top hat controlling puppet world map. Mood: Ominous conspiracy.
